# Privacy Data-Flow Inventory Planner

## Purpose
Maps what data a client system collects, stores, shares, and retains for privacy review.

## Workflow
1. Scope systems and business processes with the client.
2. Inventory data categories, collection points, purposes, storage locations, recipients, retention periods, access roles, and deletion paths using approved documentation.
3. Mark unknowns explicitly and distinguish observed facts from owner assertions.
4. Identify unnecessary collection and questions requiring privacy counsel or a data protection officer.

## Output
Data-flow register, system boundary map, retention and access questions, data-minimization opportunities, and evidence-gap list.

## Safety and limits
- Do not collect live personal data or make legal compliance certifications. Do not access accounts or alter retention settings. No runtime activation or tool grants.
- Research, drafting, and planning only; execution requires a separate future approval and reviewed integration.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Intake candidate only.
